title: Ar tonelico: Melody of Elemia
synopsis: Gust’s first Ar tonelico on PlayStation 2 — the NIS America Premium Box that opened the Gust holdings on this shelf.

curatorNotes:
Ar tonelico is where the Gust holdings on this shelf begin. It was bought on a whim, and it turned out to be the game that made the rest of this era worth seeking out: a tower-bound world, Reyvateils whose songs are both weapon and confession, and a Dive system that asks the player to walk through another character’s mind.

Gust developed it and Banpresto published it in Japan in January 2006. NIS America brought it to North America on February 6, 2007, and chose to ship the whole first run in a Premium Box with a 52-page hardcover art book — an unusual commitment for a niche PlayStation 2 RPG, and part of why the object matters as much as the disc.

This filing is the first point in the Ar tonelico lineage on the shelf. Ar tonelico II sits beside it; the PlayStation 3 conclusion is recorded elsewhere in the archive’s log rather than claimed here.
collectionNotes:
Acquired from a collector friend while assembling the Gust PlayStation 2 shelf. The copy arrived near mint and complete in its Premium Box.

The retained object is the North American NIS America Premium Box (SLUS-21445P): the printed slipcover, the standard keep case with pressed disc, manual, and cover insert, and the 52-page hardcover art book. The bonus soundtrack NIS America offered for online preorders was a separate item and is not part of this box.

The reference photograph records the seven Gust PlayStation 2 holdings together, as filed in the Collection Hall under synthesis.

preservation.playableOn: Sony PlayStation 2; compatible North American PlayStation hardware
preservation.compatibility: Pressed for North American PlayStation 2 consoles. The retained game disc remains the primary access copy.
preservation.concerns: Optical-disc aging and surface damage remain the principal risks, alongside wear to the premium box itself. The game case is stored upright under stable, dry conditions; the box, printed extras, and any soundtrack disc remain housed together with the copy.
preservation.knownRevisions: First issued in Japan by Banpresto on January 26, 2006 as アルトネリコ 世界の終わりで詩い続ける少女. The North American NIS America localization followed on February 6, 2007 (SLUS-21445), sold in the Premium Box with the hardcover art book. The European 505 Games release of May 2007 is a separate edition and is not this filing.
preservation.availability: The original physical edition is out of print and circulates through the secondary market; complete Premium Boxes are the scarcer form. No current digital edition replaces this North American reference copy.
